column1: # Poland's economy. gdp_nominal_pln_bn / gdp_growth_pct / cpi_pct: GUS
# and hicp_pct: the same quantities as Eurostat harmonises them. Both pairs
# are staged because the atlas draws the national line with the harmonised
# unemployment_lfs_pct is GUS's BAEL rate (the publisher prints it in two
# overlapping rows; the fetcher joins them where they agree
# continuous — see DATA_NOTES). unemployment_registered_pct is the
# administrative registered rate on the same principle.
# unemployment_estat_pct is the Eurostat LFS annual average
# from GUS's "last survey of the year" convention.
